checks.scope: Evidence-map pagination and current artifact identity

checks.observation: All inspected hash bindings match. Page 10 visibly identifies the superseding addendum. The degree-16 fibre row now begins page 11 beneath a repeated header and remains complete, preserving 2,188 profiles and 124,323 vectors. The following cap-15 rows and 2,541-case count are intact. No table overlap or cropped row was observed. The receipt's 204-fragment validation was read, not independently repeated in full.
